overall_summary: The channel shows clear outlier performance in husband-wife relationship content ('Shaadi Ke Baad Pyaar Kahan Chala Gaya?' with 1,766 views and 'पत्नी की ये बात हर पति को समझनी चाहिए' with 1,674 views). General family and relationship topics have moderate pull, while broad sad shayari underperforms significantly.

winning_patterns.evidence: Videos like 'Shaadi Ke Baad Pyaar Kahan Chala Gaya?' and 'पत्नी की ये बात हर पति को समझनी चाहिए' achieved over 1,600+ views, significantly outperforming all other topics.
winning_patterns.action: Double down on marriage and long-term relationship dynamics, focusing on unspoken domestic compromises.

winning_patterns.evidence: Titles framing a relatable question or realization drive higher curiosity and initial watch time.
winning_patterns.action: Continue using direct, conversational questions addressing common emotional blind spots in relationships.

weak_patterns.evidence: Videos like 'जिस दिन सच लिखूंगा… रिश्तों को षड्यंत्र लिखूंगा' received only 15 views.
weak_patterns.action: Avoid abstract, overly dramatic poetry; ground the emotion in concrete, daily household realities.
